overall_goal: Measure, melt, and stir butter in a microwavable jug

goals.description: Set up the weighing scale and measuring jug
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the digital scale and measuring jug, placing the jug on the scale and turning it on to prepare for measuring.

goals.description: Retrieve a knife and unwrap the butter
goals.rationale: The person brings out the wrapped butter, gets a knife from the drawer, and unwraps the butter for cutting.

goals.description: Cut the butter and measure it into the jug
goals.rationale: The person uses the knife to cut pieces of butter and drops them into the measuring jug on the scale.

goals.description: Place the jug of butter into the microwave to heat
goals.rationale: The person puts down the knife, opens the microwave, places the jug inside, and sets the time to melt the butter.

goals.description: Remove the melted butter from the microwave and stir it
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a fork, takes the jug out of the microwave, and stirs the melted butter while checking the measurement.
